entry.name: zmap
entry.digest: Maps input range of values to output range
entry.description: Maps an input range of values and to an output range of values. Similar to scale, but clips values to the ranges, and does not allow inverted scaling.

arguments.name: minimum-input
arguments.description: The minimum input value. If the low values is higher than the corresponding high value, the two values are reversed to preserve the high-low relationship.

arguments.name: maximum-input
arguments.description: The maximum input value. If the low values is higher than the corresponding high value, the two values are reversed to preserve the high-low relationship.

arguments.name: minimum-output
arguments.description: The minimum output value. If the low values is higher than the corresponding high value, the two values are reversed to preserve the high-low relationship. Theobject will clip to the boundaries of the output range.

arguments.name: maximum-output
arguments.description: The maximum output value. If the low values is higher than the corresponding high value, the two values are reversed to preserve the high-low relationship. Theobject will clip to the boundaries of the output range.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Perform the scaling operation on the most recently received input value. If the range values have been changed, the scaling will be based on the new range.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: The incoming value is scaled according to the mapping provided by the arguments, or values received in the other inlets.Note: The preservation of the high-low relationship is different from the behavior of theobject, which lets you do reverse scaling. Also, note that theobject will clip to the boundaries of the output range.

messages.name: ft1
messages.description: In second inlet: Sets the low input value. If the value is higher than the high input value, the two values are reversed to preserve the high-low relationship.

messages.name: ft2
messages.description: In third inlet: Sets the high input value. If the value is lower than the low input value, the two values are reversed to preserve the high-low relationship.

messages.name: ft3
messages.description: In fourth inlet: Sets the low output value. If the value is higher than the high output value, the two values are reversed to preserve the high-low relationship.

messages.name: ft4
messages.description: In right inlet: Sets the high output value. If the value is higher than the high output value, the two values are reversed to preserve the high-low relationship.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Scale all elements of a list
messages.description: In left inlet: A list of numbers sent to the left inlet will trigger the output of a list consisting of the results of performing the specified scaling operation on each item in the input list.
